channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Ferguson Marine sets out reform programme and future vision
item.description: Ferguson Marine said historic issues are now being addressed, with structural reforms and a government-backed modernisation programme reshaping the yard’s future. The post Ferguson Marine sets out reform programme and future vision first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: French nuclear attack submarine arrives in Scotland
item.description: A French Navy Suffren-class nuclear-powered attack submarine has arrived at HM Naval Base Clyde in Scotland. The post French nuclear attack submarine arrives in Scotland first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: HII selected to design and build new US Navy frigate
item.description: HII’s Ingalls Shipbuilding division has been selected by the US Navy to design and build its future small surface combatant, using a derivative of the Legend-class National Security Cutter, after issues with the FREMM design. The post HII selected to design and build new US Navy frigate first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British Apache gunships to be fitted with APKWS rockets
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that the Advanced Precision Kill Weapon System (APKWS) will be part of the weapons mix for the British Army’s AH-64E Apache attack helicopters, with integration planned for 2027. The post British Apache gunships to be fitted with APKWS rockets first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO backs £2.5bn 2026 budget to boost collective defence
item.description: At a meeting of the North Atlantic Council on 16 December, Allies approved a Civil Budget of about £455 million and a Military Budget of roughly £2.1 billion. The post NATO backs £2.5bn 2026 budget to boost collective defence first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Boeing expands UK footprint with Spirit takeover
item.description: Boeing has formally expanded its UK presence following the completion of its acquisition of Spirit AeroSystems, bringing major aerospace operations in Northern Ireland and Scotland under Boeing ownership. The post Boeing expands UK footprint with Spirit takeover first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: No decision yet on how many drones to fly with Apache
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that no decision has yet been made on how many Land Autonomous Collaborative Platforms could ultimately be procured to operate alongside the Army’s AH-64E Apache helicopters, as it set out the formal competition timeline for Project NYX. The post No decision yet on how many drones to fly with Apache first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Rosyth facility timeline linked to Dreadnought Barrow exit
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that the planned Contingent Docking Facility at Rosyth Dockyard will be delivered in line with HMS Dreadnought’s departure from Barrow. The post Rosyth facility timeline linked to Dreadnought Barrow exit first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: MPs warn UK lags behind allies on drones
item.description: Senior Ministry of Defence officials have faced blunt criticism from MPs over the pace at which the UK is fielding drones and one-way effectors, amid warnings that British forces lag behind key European allies in deployed capability. The post MPs warn UK lags behind allies on drones first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: France to build large new nuclear aircraft carrier
item.description: France has formally decided to proceed with the construction of a next-generation nuclear-powered aircraft carrier. The post France to build large new nuclear aircraft carrier first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
